title: Warm Crisp Norwegian Porcini Gratin
description: A rich and earthy Norwegian dish featuring porcini mushrooms, perfect for a date night, with a crispy crust and a warm, umami flavor, made in a terracotta dish and steamed to perfection using the mushimono method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter a terracotta dish and set it aside.
In a large skillet, saute the porcini mushrooms in butter until they are tender and fragrant.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, grana padano cheese, eggs, heavy cream, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked mushrooms to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the cheese mixture.
Pour the mixture into the prepared terracotta dish and smooth the top.
Place the dish in a large steamer basket and steam the gratin over boiling water for 15 minutes, using the mushimono method.
Remove the dish from the steamer and top it with additional grated cheese.
Place the dish under the broiler and cook until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
